info.title: Paperclip API
info.description: JSON search and document API for Paperclip. Default search corpus is abstracts (title+abstract leftover). Authenticate with `X-API-Key: gxl_…` or `Authorization: Bearer gxl_…`.

post.summary: Search papers, trials, FDA documents, patents, or proteins
Retrieve papers by pmid, doi, year, or other metadata fields
Citing-paper lists for up to 10,000 papers in one request
post.description:
Bulk read against the citation-graph snapshot.

One auth check and one round trip for the whole batch; each id costs
an in-memory array read upstream. Returns, per id: `found`, the
resolved `work`, the exact `total`, and up to `limit` neighbors in
the requested `direction` (identifiers + count by default,
full metadata with `hydrate: true`).

post.summary: Evidence for and against a scientific claim
post.description:
Hunt the literature for a claim: vector search over full-text passages
plus a keyword add-on, and a per-passage supports/refutes judgment.
Returns classified evidence with paper metadata and citation counts.
Passages are receipts, not rulings — callers weigh them.

post.summary: Journal and institution quality for claim evidence

ids.title: Ids
ids.description: Paper identifiers: doi:…, pmid:…, arxiv:…, or a bare DOI.

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: cited_by returns the papers citing each id; references returns what each id cites.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum neighbors returned per id (total counts are always exact).

hydrate.title: Hydrate
hydrate.description: If true, each neighbor carries full metadata (title, year); default is identifiers + count.

CitationsBatchRequest.title: CitationsBatchRequest
CitationsBatchRequest.description:
Bulk citation-graph read: the citing-paper (or reference) list for
up to 10,000 papers in one request. One auth check, one round trip —
every lookup is an in-memory array read against the graph snapshot.

ClaimReputationRequest.title: ClaimReputationRequest
ClaimReputationRequest.description:
Journal and institution quality for evidence papers already returned
by /claims/support (scored on demand, cached per journal).

claim.title: Claim
claim.description: The scientific claim to find evidence for and against.

top_n.title: Top N
top_n.description: Size of the vector candidate pool, before the keyword add-on.

min_conf.title: Min Conf
min_conf.description: Confidence floor for a passage to be returned as evidence.

min_sim.title: Min Sim
min_sim.description: Similarity floor applied to the vector leg.

hybrid.title: Hybrid
hybrid.description: Add the best keyword (BM25) hits the vector leg missed.

ClaimSupportRequest.title: ClaimSupportRequest
ClaimSupportRequest.description:
Evidence retrieval for a scientific claim: vector search over full-text
passages plus a keyword add-on, then per-passage supports/refutes
judgments. Returns classified evidence with paper metadata and citation
counts — receipts, not rulings.

field.title: Field
field.description: CLI lookup field: pmid, doi, pmc, arxiv, title, author, journal, year, keywords, type.

LookupRequest.title: LookupRequest
LookupRequest.description:
Retrieve papers by identifier or metadata field.

Send one of the first-class keys (`pmid`, `doi`, `pmc`, `year`, …)
or the generic `field` + `value` pair. Response papers use the same
citable shape as search (`id`, `title`, `pmid`, `doi`, `year`, `source`).

min_year.title: Min Year
min_year.description: Inclusive lower bound on publication year, applied in the index.

max_year.title: Max Year
max_year.description: Inclusive upper bound on publication year, applied in the index.

year.title: Year
year.description: Exact publication year. Hits with unknown year are kept.

published_after.title: Published After
published_after.description: Inclusive lower bound as YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY. Year-granular alias of min_year.

published_before.title: Published Before
published_before.description: Inclusive upper bound as YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY. Year-granular alias of max_year.

id.title: Id
id.description: Paperclip document id (work id / PMC / preprint id).

pmid.title: Pmid
pmid.description: PubMed id, or absent. Never the internal document id.

year.title: Year
year.description: Publication year. Null when unknown — the hit is still returned.

query.title: Query
query.description: Search query. Required unless `queries` is set.

queries.title: Queries
queries.description: Fan-out: search several phrasings in one call. Candidate pools are fused server-side (reciprocal rank fusion), deduplicated (PMID, then DOI, then normalized title) and reranked once against `rerank_query` (default: `query` or the first entry). Max 20.

rerank_query.title: Rerank Query
rerank_query.description: Question the fused candidate pool is reranked against. Defaults to `query` (or the first of `queries`). Use it to pass the user's original question when `queries` are keyword rewrites.

expand.title: Expand
expand.description: Generate additional phrasings of the query with an LLM (synonyms, gene symbols, sub-topics) and fan them out like `queries`. Improves recall on broad questions at the cost of latency.

num_results.title: Num Results
num_results.description: Papers to return (1–200). The engine retrieves a pool several times deeper, reranks the whole pool, then returns the top `num_results`. Ranking reorders; it does not filter.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Corpus. Default is abstracts (title+abstract leftover via the Qwen chunk index — PubMed/Crossref, not OpenAlex, not PMC). `pmc` / `papers` are a different full-text collection. Choose explicitly.

ranking.title: Ranking
ranking.description: hybrid = BM25+vector fused; bm25 = lexical (named-entity / rare-disease); vector = conceptual. Recency is a separate knob.

recency.title: Recency
recency.description: off = full corpus (default). boost = last-~2-years window. Any year bound disables the recency window even if boost is set.
